name: Return to Rorian
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You've done enough here, champion. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
narrative.objectives: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
narrative.offerRewardText: This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, Ranir. Thank you.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 3 to 5, 1,090 XP in all.

quests.name: Elemental Unrest
quests.objectiveText: Speak to the Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.

quests.name: Agitators
quests.objectiveText: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.

quests.name: Return to Rorian
quests.objectiveText: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.

quests.name: Foul Matriarch
quests.objectiveText: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.

quests.name: The Next Step
quests.objectiveText: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
